page.intro: Your body and mind tell a story that is sometimes hard to hear amidst the noise. This mapping helps you validate your experiences.

feedback.title: IMMEDIATE FEEDBACK
feedback.text: You get validation for every answer.

analysis.title: RISK ANALYSIS
analysis.text: Understand the severity of your situation.

questions.question: Do you doubt your mental health or memory?
questions.validationText: Constant questioning makes the victim doubt their own reality. This is a normal reaction to an abnormal situation.

questions.question: Do you avoid social situations at work?
questions.validationText: Withdrawal is a defense mechanism. When the environment is unsafe, the mind tries to minimize risks by isolating.

questions.question: Do you have stomach pain or headache on workdays?
questions.validationText: The body reacts to threat often before the mind. Chronic stress manifests as physical pain.

questions.question: Do you feel fear when phone rings or you get a message?
questions.validationText: Nervous system is in constant 'fight or flight' mode. This is a sign of severe load.

questions.question: Do you blame yourself for others' bad behavior?
questions.validationText: Bullying dynamics include shifting blame to the victim. You are not guilty for others' choices.

questions.question: Is it hard for you to make decisions?
questions.validationText: When self-esteem is eroded, trust in own abilities disappears. Decision making becomes difficult.

questions.question: Do you feel like you are 'worse' than others?
questions.validationText: Constant invalidation effects self-image. Remember that workplace bullying does not tell about your value.

questions.question: Has your sleep quality deteriorated?
questions.validationText: Hyperarousal prevents recovery. Sleep is one of the first things disturbed in crisis.

questions.question: Do you feel like no one is on your side?
questions.validationText: Bullying isolates. The feeling is real, but it doesn't mean help wouldn't exist.

questions.question: Do you feel stuck in the situation?
questions.validationText: Prolonged stress creates a feeling that there is no way out. This is an illusion of the mind - there are always options.

results.title: Your Situation Picture
results.remember_text: This result is just a momentary snapshot. It does not define your future, nor is it a diagnosis. It is a tool with which you can navigate towards safer waters.
